entries.name: GitHub Spec Kit
entries.summary: Structured feature and bug workflows, project artifacts, and an IBM Bob skills adapter with managed installation.
notes: Reviewed v1.2.1 release commit: 9dca9bf42a031765ee5e5f2371137f2f26967e11. No execution was performed by this catalogue.
Spec Kit's Bob integration defaults to project .bob/skills/speckit-<command>/SKILL.md with hyphenated invocation; its legacy Bob 1.x command layout is deprecated.
Includes a separate assess/fix/test bug workflow with per-bug reports and partial/not-run verification states.
Integration management already tracks hashes, rolls back failed installation, and preserves modified files on uninstall.
Latest observed release was v1.2.1, published on 2026-10-16. Its Bob adapter remains skills-first and retains the documented legacy-layout migration path.

The v1.2.1 release adds opt-in per-stream-limited workflow output capture with timeout/interruption fields and process-tree cleanup, plus catalogue trust and source-precedence guidance. Captured text is stored unredacted and treated as untrusted. These are upstream source observations, not installation or Bob runtime evidence.

entries.name: Verified Codebase Context
entries.summary: A Spec Kit preset generating evidence-qualified repository context and adding it to plan, tasks, analyze and implement workflows.
notes: Reviewed v1.1.0 source at 52b67e61b0ecdac0aec7c17acb0852e0355f31c1. No execution was performed by this catalogue.
Bob relationship is through the host Spec Kit integration. The documented test matrix names Codex, Claude, Copilot and Gemini, not Bob; Bob compatibility is unverified.
Writes .specify/memory/codebase.md using direct reads/search, coverage checks and preserved manual overrides. Graph enhancement is optional.
Four full core-command replacements target Spec Kit 1.1.2; later versions or other replacement presets require compatibility review.
The generator records commands without executing them. A write-time content comparison does not guarantee protection from concurrent edits.
Upstream field reports are linked in the README; they were not independently reproduced or promoted to catalogue runtime records.

entries.name: Headless Bob
entries.summary: The headlessbob service in IBM Building Blocks exposes Bob through REST, ACP and MCP with sessions, run storage and cancellation.
notes: Reviewed source revision: 5c610971dc72f9e9035821b3cb2c3edea868f8b4; package 0.4.0. This catalogue did not execute or deploy it.
A distinct runnable application within Building Blocks. The repository field points to its source subdirectory.
The reviewed README documents Node.js 22.22+ and Bob Shell 2.0.4, SQLite persistence, concurrency/output/time limits, and Python clients.
The trust model is for trusted operators; token ownership checks do not provide an OS sandbox between untrusted callers.
Maintainer verification notes describe fixture and live Bob checks plus deployment stages. They were not reproduced here or promoted to structured runtime evidence.
The repository root license applies to project source; inspect dependency and bundled specification notices before redistribution.
